description: Test distribution systems for optimal switch placement is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Mohammad Jooshaki. A dataset including five test distribution systems for switch optimization purposes. Two of the systems, namely 37- and 64-node systems, are small-scale networks. The 186-node network is a rural network, the 230-node system represents an urban/suburban grid, and the 1000-node is a mixed urban, suburban, and rural network. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
